name: Alert
summary: Contextual, in-page message about the state of a task, region or system.

accessibility.notes:
ARIA: Static messages are plain regions; messages appearing in response to an action use `role="alert"` or `role="status"`.
Keyboard: Dismiss and action controls are focusable; Escape may dismiss a page-level banner.

use_when: Explaining an error, warning about consequences, confirming a state that persists
avoid_when: The message is transient — use a toast
It blocks the flow — use a dialog

resolved.title: All five base states
resolved.statement: Every interactive component implements enabled, hover, focus-visible, active and disabled with a defined visual treatment, including in dark mode.
resolved.rationale: Most "the UI looks unfinished" complaints are missing states, not missing components.

detect.static: For each interactive element, the stylesheet or class list defines treatments for :hover, :focus-visible, :active and [disabled] / [aria-disabled].
detect.runtime: Drive each state and diff computed styles against the enabled state; each must differ in at least one property.

resolved.fix: Add the missing state using the component's token deltas (see its states[] treatment).

resolved.title: No state by colour alone
resolved.statement: No state is expressed by colour alone; every state has a second channel (icon, weight, border, position or text).

detect.static: A state's class delta changes only color/background-color.
detect.runtime: Grayscale the screenshot of each state and check it still differs from enabled.

resolved.fix: Add an icon, border, weight or text change alongside the colour change.

resolved.title: Every state reaches the accessibility tree
resolved.statement: Every visible state has an ARIA expression or an explicit "none" in the spec; selected, expanded, invalid, busy and current are never visual-only.

detect.static: For each state the component declares, the matching attribute (aria-selected, aria-expanded, aria-invalid, aria-busy, aria-current, aria-checked) is present when the state is active.

resolved.fix: Set the attribute the APG pattern specifies; do not invent a new one.

resolved.title: Never remove focus without replacing it
resolved.statement: No `outline: none` / `outline-0` / `focus:outline-none` without a `:focus-visible` replacement that has ≥3:1 contrast against both the component and the page.

detect.static: Class or style removes outline and no focus-visible ring class/rule exists on the same element.
detect.runtime: Tab to the element; the focused and unfocused screenshots must differ at ≥3:1 along the element's edge.

resolved.fix: Use `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-ring ring-offset-2` (or the binding's equivalent) and keep `:focus` untouched.

resolved.title: Native element first
resolved.statement: Prefer the native element (button, a, select, details, input) until a product requirement makes it impossible; a div or span with a click handler and a role is a defect unless the spec names an exception.

detect.static: div|span with onClick/onKeyDown and no native equivalent in the subtree.

resolved.fix: Replace with the native element; keep the styling.

resolved.title: Every control has an accessible name
resolved.statement: Every interactive element has an accessible name from content, a label, aria-label or aria-labelledby; placeholder text and title attributes do not count.

detect.static: Compute the accessible name per accname 1.2; empty is a failure.

resolved.fix: Add visible text, a <label>, or aria-label for icon-only controls.

resolved.title: No literal values
resolved.statement: Component styles read token roles only, through the binding's custom properties; no literal colours, radii, shadows, durations or z-indexes (`#7c3aed`, `oklch(…)`, `border-radius: 12px`, `z-index: 50`, `300ms`).
resolved.rationale: Tokens are the primer; the component is the finish. A literal value breaks every theme at once.

detect.static: A declaration on a component part sets colour, radius, shadow, duration or z-index to anything other than `var(--lq-…)` (or a utility class that does not resolve to a role through the binding).

resolved.fix: Replace with the role's custom property from the binding (see spec/bindings/html.yaml).

resolved.title: Parts are addressable
resolved.statement: Every anatomy part renders with `data-slot="<part>"` so docs, tests and the grader can target it without classes.

detect.static: For each anatomy part marked required, an element with that data-slot exists.

resolved.fix: Add data-slot to the part's root element.

missing: states.treatment: enabled, hover, focus-visible, success, warning, invalid
states.a11y: enabled, hover, focus-visible, success, warning, invalid
rules.local (three or more, at least one forbid)
